children: Almonty Industries signed a long-term take-or-pay tungsten concentrate offtake with Sandvik unit WBH for Los Santos tailings, including a conditional $3M one-time upfront payment. The deal supports a planned restart and provides index-linked pricing with a floor.
De-risks sales for the Los Santos restart; improves revenue visibility.
Provides near-term cash to support plant reinstatement; reduces funding gap.
Offers price protection while retaining upside to tungsten indices.
Faster-to-market, lower capex path vs new mining; potential quick cash flow.
Positions Almonty for demand tied to 2027 U.S. defense sourcing rules.

This is an early-to-mid step in Almonty’s plan to restart Los Santos and secure non-Chinese tungsten supply alongside Sangdong. A firm restart decision, meeting conditions precedent, and initial shipments under the contract would turn this into a larger catalyst.
